notes: This contract directly traces the portable ordinary-interaction slice to the pinned standard MIM entry and IEEE 1516.1 clause 11.4.1. It does not claim to test the MIM entry's separate DDM-accounting semantic. An installed-package run is bounded provider evidence, not proof of provider-independent behavior or conformance.

requirements.statement: The standard MIM declares HLAinteractionsSent as an HLAcount updated periodically according to HLAsetTiming.HLAreportPeriod using reliable receive-order delivery. This focused scenario checks the ordinary application Send Interaction contribution: after capturing a direct baseline with periodic reporting enabled, three accepted application sends must raise the direct and periodic values by exactly three. The MIM's additional DDM-accounting semantic is explicitly outside this case.
